app.title: Schwips
settings.title: Settings
settings.keepAwakeHint: The display stays on during a game.
settings.hideSpicyHint: Hides the spicy category in every game.
settings.hiddenHint: During a game: Pause → “Don't show this card again”.
settings.resetConfirm: Really reset everything? Your player list, own cards, hidden cards and all settings will be deleted permanently.
about.text: All cards are original texts. Nobody has to drink – water counts as a sip too.
about.privacy: No account, no ads, no tracking. Your player list and language stay on this device.
players.title: Players
players.lead: Who's playing? Type a name, then tap “Man” or “Woman”.
players.empty: Nobody here yet. You need at least 2 players.
players.pickGender: Tap “Man” or “Woman” to add this player.
players.clearConfirm: Really remove all players? This is permanent and can't be undone.
setup.loadError: Couldn't load the cards. Please try again.
game.swipeHint: Tap or swipe left for the next card
custom.title: Your own cards
custom.lead: Write your own cards. They appear in both languages exactly as you type them and stay on this device only.
custom.err.placeholder: That placeholder isn't allowed here. Only the ones in the tip work.
custom.empty: No custom cards for this game yet.
custom.deleteConfirm: Delete this card permanently? This can't be undone.
backup.title: Backup
backup.text: Save your own and hidden cards as a file, e.g. to iCloud Drive.
backup.reminder: more than 30 days ago, please back up again
backup.importText.one: The file contains 1 custom card. “Merge” keeps your current cards, “Replace” deletes them permanently.
backup.importText.other: The file contains {n} custom cards. “Merge” keeps your current cards, “Replace” deletes them permanently.
backup.invalid: This file isn't a valid Schwips backup.
custom.err.long: The text is too long (240 characters max).
end.title: That's all the cards!
update.offline: No connection – please try again later.
